mapper.select: select * from TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL tptd where BUSI_TYPE =#{busiType} and TRADE_DATE =#{batchDate} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt WHERE tptd.FINPROD_ID =tfpdt.FINPROD_ID AND tfpdt.MDATE =tptd.MDATE AND tfpdt.IS_CANCEL ='N' AND tfpdt.TRADE_STATUS ='01' AND tfpdt.PS ='T07' )

SELECT T1.CCY, T4.BASIS, T4.INT_RATE, T1.COUNTER_ID, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.TRADER, T4.FINPROD_ID, T2.PORTFOLIO_ID, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T5.TYPE_6 type_6, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 , T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, to_char(T1.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE, to_char(T4.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate/*计息开始日*/, to_char(T4.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate/*计息结束日*/, to_char(T4.MPAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mpayDate/**/, T4.TERM,/*回购期限*/ T1.PRIN_AMT THEORY_PRIN/*理论本金*/, T1.TRADE_MARKET TradeMarket, #{batchDate} SETTLE_DATE, T1.PRIN_AMT + FCP.INT_AMT THEORY_AMT/*理论本息总额 T1.PRIN_AMT + NVL(PSV.TDY_INTINCEXP, FCP.INT_AMT)*/, T1.PRIN_AMT + FCP.INT_AMT FPRICE_AMT, T1.PRIN_AMT + FCP.INT_AMT TRADE_AMT ,T1.PS/*交易方向*/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp1 on fp1.FINPROD_ID = T1.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON T1.FINPROD_ID = FCI.FINPROD_ID AND T1.CCY = FCI.CCY AND FCI.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN FCP ON FCI.CASH_ID = FCP.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T5 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID WHERE t1.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND T1.TRADE_MARKET IN ('03','04') AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F02', 'F03') AND T1.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND T1.PS = 'T01' AND T2.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID is null AND T2.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND T4.MDATE=#{batchDate} AND T5.TYPE_6 ='H02' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt WHERE t1.FINPROD_ID =tfpdt.FINPROD_ID AND tfpdt.MDATE =t4.MDATE AND tfpdt.IS_CANCEL ='N' AND tfpdt.TRADE_STATUS ='01' AND tfpdt.PS ='T07' )
